items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Speaking of that, Ravi Coltrane came to Hamilton once. And he looked so much like his father. And I was sitting next to him and it was a very weird feeling. [INTERVIEWEE] Eerie, huh?

ctx.x: Well I’m so glad that his son picked up the mantle after trying the rhythm & blues world for a couple of years. It’s just like Natalie Cole. You want to do what your father did.
